Step 2 of 4

02. Make your FLO.

Start with a month-long course. Drink FLO three times a week. Begin with ¼ scoop (1.875 g) and adjust your serving based on your tolerance. Do not exceed 2 scoops (15 g) per day.

Add ¼ scoop of FLO to 250 ml of cold water and stir until dissolved. The carefully selected blend makes FLO naturally cloudy. Some powder may remain in the drink or settle at the bottom of the glass. This is a natural feature of the blend and part of what gives FLO its character.

Reach for FLO when you need a moment to yourself. If you want to build a habit, pick a regular time. To round off the moment, make FLO in whatever you most enjoy drinking from.

Step 3 of 4

03. Take a moment with FLO

Most people begin the day straight with stimuli. A moment for yourself, before you go into overdrive, can change the entire rhythm of the day.

High drive isn’t the problem. Unconscious momentum is.

You can’t regulate what you don’t notice.
Awareness is where change begins.
